name: Torrejón el Rubio (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torrejón el Rubio (a tower on white with the motto TRABAJO, PAZ, ALMONTE, TAJO).
history: Municipal flag of Torrejón el Rubio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torrejón el Rubio arms — tower on white with motto
